headline: Kai, the Fed sits down this morning with markets calling tomorrow's decision a hold — and keeping one-in-ten odds on a hike.
subline: Israel votes with neither bloc assured a Knesset majority, Coca-Cola and Boeing open a packed earnings day, and bitcoin starts the morning under $80,000.
asof: Pre-market · as of 6:40 AM ET · index values are Monday's close, deltas are overnight futures · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Fed meeting opens; hike odds small but live
items.sentence: The two-day meeting starts today with the decision due Wednesday, and after hotter-than-expected inflation CME pricing implies about 10 percent odds of a hike rather than a hold, per Yahoo Finance — the Conference Board's October consumer-confidence reading is this morning's main data print.

items.title: Monday's rally set the table
items.sentence: The S&P 500 rose 0.7 percent Monday to 7,676.77, the Nasdaq added 0.8 percent to 26,169.38 and the Dow closed at 52,361.58, per AP's wrap carried by Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Coca-Cola, Boeing, Robinhood lead today's earnings
items.sentence: Coca-Cola, Boeing and Robinhood headline today's slate, with Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon due later in the week, per TipRanks.

items.title: Crude holds near six-month highs
items.sentence: Brent trades near $116, close to six-month highs, after renewed Houthi strikes on Saudi oil infrastructure, with diplomacy hopes out of Tehran capping the move, per ARY News and TipRanks.

items.title: Bitcoin starts the day under $80,000
items.sentence: Bitcoin slipped back below $80,000 to about $79,770, down more than 4 percent this month, after US spot ETFs shed $635.6 million on October 22 and traders turned cautious into the Fed, per Analytics Insight.

items.title: Israel votes; Netanyahu could linger either way
items.sentence: Israelis are voting today in the first national election since October 7, 2023, and with neither Netanyahu's coalition nor Gadi Eisenkot's bloc assured 61 Knesset seats, Netanyahu could run a caretaker government with war powers for months, per Euronews.

items.title: Saudis intercept missiles aimed at oil heartland
items.sentence: The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted three Houthi ballistic missiles aimed at the oil-rich Eastern Province and four drones headed south on Tuesday, a day after Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials met Iranian counterparts in Tehran and agreed to keep talking, per Al Jazeera.

items.title: Midterms one week out; average sits D+7.4
items.sentence: Election Day is one week from today, and US Polling Data's tracker puts the generic-ballot average at D+7.4 with Trump approval at 37 percent.

items.title: Kyiv hit overnight; firefighters pull dog free
items.sentence: Firefighters battled fires across Kyiv and pulled a dog from the rubble after an overnight Russian attack on the capital, per Euronews.

items.title: Anthropic will list as ANT on Nasdaq
items.sentence: Fresh S-1 detail has Anthropic listing as ANT on Nasdaq later this fall with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley leading, Q2 operating income turning positive at $974 million, and Wall Street talk of a roughly $2 trillion valuation, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: OpenAI claims a machine-checked complexity landmark
items.sentence: OpenAI says an internal model produced a Lean-verified disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis — a conjecture hundreds of computer-science papers lean on — and the researchers who proposed it are organizing an unpaid independent review, per The Next Web.

items.title: Nvidia puts $3 billion into Meta offering
items.sentence: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta's share offering and expand their partnership around Meta's Muse AI agent, per Reuters.

items.title: SK Hynix pops on special-dividend report
items.sentence: US-listed SK Hynix rose about 3 percent premarket on reports the memory maker is weighing a special dividend of roughly $12 billion, per TipRanks.
